lines: Dard minnat-kash-e-dawa na hua
couplets.en: My pain owed nothing to the remedy.

lines: Dard minnat-kash-e-dawa na hua
Main na achchha hua, bura na hua
couplets.en: My pain owed nothing to the remedy, and I grew neither better nor worse.

lines: Kya woh Namrood ki khudai thi?
couplets.en: Was that the godhood Nimrod claimed?

lines: Kya woh Namrood ki khudai thi?
Bandagi mein mera bhala na hua
couplets.en: What kind of god was Nimrod, if all my worship did me no good?

lines: Bandagi mein mera bhala na hua
couplets.en: All my worship did me no good.

lines: Bandagi mein mera bhala na hua
couplets.en: All my worship did me no good.

lines: Hum kahan qismat aazmane jaayen?
couplets.en: Where am I to go to try my luck?

lines: Hum kahan qismat aazmane jaayen?
Jab tu hi khanjar-aazma na hua
couplets.en: Where am I to try my luck when even you would not try your dagger?

lines: Jab tu hi khanjar-aazma na hua
couplets.en: Even you would not try your dagger.

lines: Jab tu hi khanjar-aazma na hua
couplets.en: Even you would not try your dagger.

lines: Jama karte ho kyun raqeebon ko?
couplets.en: Why do you gather my rivals?

lines: Jama karte ho kyun raqeebon ko?
Ek tamasha hua, gila na hua
couplets.en: Why gather my rivals when it only makes a spectacle of my grievance?

lines: Ek tamasha hua, gila na hua
couplets.en: It all became a spectacle, and my grievance went unsaid.

lines: Kuchh to kahiye, ki log kehte hain
couplets.en: Do say something, for people are beginning to talk.
